sentences.en: Julie, you have spent the past many months investigating the plight of these roughly 200 Venezuelan nationals who were deported by the Trump administration from the U.S.

sentences.en: And now you bring us your latest investigation.

sentences.en: So I think that so many listeners remember back in March when these 250 or so Venezuelan men were put on planes to this foreign prison in El Salvador,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，许多听众都还记得3月份的时候，大约250名委内瑞拉男子被送上飞机，飞往萨尔瓦多的这座外国监狱，

sentences.en: and then, in a very, very public way, taken off the planes, bent at the waist, shackled, shaved, and put in this maximum security prison in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 然后，在非常非常公开的情况下，他们被带下飞机，腰部弯曲，戴着脚镣，剃光头发，关进萨尔瓦多的这座最高安全级别监狱里。

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: Absolutely.

sentences.en: And after that, the men disappeared.

sentences.en: Absolutely.

sentences.en: The only ways that we found out who they were was through leaks.

sentences.en: And what emerges is this pretty clear and very consistent account of widespread abuse among the men inside the prison.

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 他在那里告诉官员他患有糖尿病，需要胰岛素。

sentences.en: They also say that they are consistently denied medical care.
sentences.zh: 他说他连续五天被拒绝提供胰岛素。

sentences.en: There is one man named Aldo Colmenares who comes into the prison with diabetes.
sentences.zh: 他最终被给予了错误种类的胰岛素，这导致了低血糖以及导致他昏厥的发作。

sentences.en: He tells officials there he has diabetes and needs insulin.
sentences.zh: 有个年轻人病得非常非常重，其他同狱犯人用手把食物和水送到他嘴边，

sentences.en: He said that he was denied insulin for five days.
sentences.zh: 他最终被送到医务室，据他说，一名医生告诉他应该认命了。

sentences.en: He's eventually given the wrong kind of insulin, which leads to hypoglycemia and to attacks that lead him to pass out.
sentences.zh: 是时候去死了。

sentences.en: There is a young man who becomes very, very sick to the point where the other inmates are bringing food and water to his lips with their hands,
sentences.zh: 这太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: and he's eventually sent to an infirmary where he says that a doctor told him he should just resign himself.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，这些人谈论的只是持续不断的身体虐待。

sentences.en: It is time to die.
sentences.zh: 这意味着殴打、被踢打和拖拽。

sentences.en: That's stunning.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着限制体位。

sentences.en: And for the most part, what these men speak about is just constant physical abuse.
sentences.zh: 许多人谈到了一种他们称为“起重机体位”（the grúa position）的姿势。

sentences.en: This means beatings, being kicked and dragged.
sentences.zh: 他们被迫跪立数小时，双手反铐在背后，有时甚至被手铐吊起，以给肩膀和背部施加压力。

sentences.en: And it also means restraint positions.
sentences.zh: 有时在这个姿势下，他们的脚和手还会被踩踏。

sentences.en: Many of the men spoke about a position they called the grúa position, the crane position.
sentences.zh: 这听起来就像是酷刑。

sentences.en: They were forced to kneel for hours and handcuffed behind their backs and then at times lifted by the handcuffs to put pressure on their shoulders and backs.
sentences.zh: 他们被迫跪了几个小时，双手被反铐在背后，有时甚至被手铐吊起来，以此对他们的肩膀和背部施压。

sentences.en: and sometimes also stomped on their feet and hands while in this position.
sentences.zh: 而且在这种姿势下，有时脚和手还会遭到踩踏。

sentences.en: It sounds like torture.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是酷刑。

sentences.en: This abuse goes on for months, and they talk about getting to points of extreme psychological desperation.
sentences.zh: 这种虐待持续了数月，他们谈到自己走到了极度心理绝望的边缘。

sentences.en: And one day, they sort of start to crack.
sentences.zh: 直到有一天，他们开始有点崩溃了。

sentences.en: And they decide that they're going to stop eating and ask for better treatment.
sentences.zh: 他们决定绝食并要求改善待遇。

sentences.en: And they decide that they want to write their messages.
sentences.zh: 他们决定写下自己的诉求。

sentences.en: They take some metal from the beds and cut themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们从床上拆下一些金属割破自己。

sentences.en: And using their own blood, write on the sheets messages like, we are not criminals, we are migrants.
sentences.zh: 并且用他们自己的血在床单上写下诸如“我们不是罪犯，我们是移民”的标语。

sentences.en: And they hang these sheets from what they called the piping in the cells.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些床单挂在他们所谓的牢房管道上。

sentences.en: I mean, they are that despondent that they are writing messages of protests in their own blood.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们绝望到用自己的血写抗议信。

sentences.en: That's how far gone the situation has become.
sentences.zh: 局势已经恶化到了这种地步。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I don't think that they believed they had any other options.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们相信自己还有别的选择。

sentences.en: And this was something.
sentences.zh: 而且这只是一部分。

sentences.en: But what happens next is an even bigger rebellion.
sentences.zh: 但接下来发生的是一场更大规模的叛乱。

sentences.en: In May, there's a guard search of one of the cells.
sentences.zh: 五月份，一名狱警搜查了其中一间牢房。

sentences.en: And during this search, officials beat a man so badly that he is bleeding from head to toe, according to Luis.
sentences.zh: 据路易斯称，在搜查过程中，官员将一名男子殴打得遍体鳞伤、头部流血。

sentences.en: And this sets off so much anger that some of the inmates dislodge metal parts from their bed and use the metal parts to open cell doors.
sentences.zh: 这激起了巨大的愤怒，一些被关押者拆下床上的金属部件，并用它们打开了牢房的门。

sentences.en: And for a moment, some of these men had this taste of something like freedom.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，其中一些人尝到了类似自由的滋味。

sentences.en: Then, of course, they immediately realized that they are completely outmatched by the guards.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，他们立刻意识到自己在狱警面前完全不堪一击。

sentences.en: Luis tells us they retreat into their cells.
sentences.zh: 路易斯告诉我们，他们退回了各自的牢房。

sentences.en: And that is when the guards begin going cell by cell and really punishing the men, shooting them at point blank with what they call rubber bullets in the hand, in the head,
sentences.zh: 就在那时，狱警开始逐个牢房地狠狠惩罚这些人，用他们所谓的橡胶子弹近距离射击他们的手、头部，

sentences.en: in the leg.
sentences.zh: 还有腿部。

sentences.en: My photographer colleague traveled around Venezuela photographing these men,
sentences.zh: 我的摄影师同事走遍委内瑞拉拍摄了这些人，

sentences.en: and you can see one of them has this gash down the front of his face that he said was caused by a rubber bullet that ricocheted off of his forehead.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到其中一人脸部正前方有一道伤口，他说这是由额头上反弹的橡胶子弹造成的。

sentences.en: There is another man who said that he was shot in the thigh with a rubber bullet and has this really sort of gnarly welt in his thigh that we documented.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个人说他大腿中了一颗橡胶子弹，我们记录下了他大腿上那个非常丑陋的肿块。

sentences.en: What happened after this shooting?
sentences.zh: 枪击事件发生后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Did these men get any kind of medical treatment?
sentences.zh: 这些人得到了任何形式的医疗救治吗？

sentences.en: So they talk about asking for medical care following these injuries.
sentences.zh: 所以他们谈到在受伤后要求医疗救助。

sentences.en: And some of them were eventually taken to an infirmary.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人最终被带到了医务室。

sentences.en: The man with the bullet in his leg, for example, talks about it being removed without any kind of anesthesia.
sentences.zh: 例如，腿上有子弹的那名男子谈到在没有任何麻醉的情况下将子弹取了出来。

sentences.en: And Luis describes how after this attempted rebellion, what really happens is there is a sort of new wave of punishment and repression inside the prison.
sentences.zh: 路易斯描述说，在这次未遂叛乱之后，真正发生的是监狱内部掀起了一波新的惩罚和镇压浪潮。

sentences.en: And what does that look like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样子的？

sentences.en: So there is an isolation room in the prison that the men spoke to us about.
sentences.zh: 监狱里有一个隔离室，这些人跟我们提起过。

sentences.en: They call La Isla the island.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为“拉伊斯拉”（小岛）。

sentences.en: And these men say that the island is really the place where some of the most depraved acts occurred.
sentences.zh: 这些人说，“小岛”确实是发生一些最令人发指的行径的地方。

sentences.en: occurred.
sentences.zh: 发生的地方。

sentences.en: Luis speaks about experiencing punishment that included having his head dunked in water as if the guards were attempting to drown him.
sentences.zh: 路易斯讲述了自己遭受的惩罚，包括头部被按进水中，仿佛狱警正试图将他溺死。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is pretty graphic for some of our listeners,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，对于我们的某些听众来说，这画面感很强，

sentences.en: but one of the inmates talks about being taken there alone by several of the guards wearing hoods who forced him to perform oral sex in this space.
sentences.zh: 但其中一名被关押者讲述了自己被几个戴着头套的狱警单独带到那里，并被强迫在该空间内进行口交的经历。

sentences.en: Julie, throughout this period, as all these horrific actions are allegedly occurring, are these men able to speak to anyone in the outside world through phone calls, emails,
sentences.zh: 朱莉，在这段期间，当所有这些可怕的行径据称正在发生时，这些人能否通过电话、电子邮件等方式与外界任何人通话，

sentences.en: anything?
sentences.zh: 或是任何方式？

sentences.en: These men are denied access to the people they want to speak to.
sentences.zh: 这些人被剥夺了与他们想要交谈的人联系的权利。

sentences.en: During this entire period, they receive two important visits, one from Kristi Noem, the head of the Department of Homeland Security, and from the Red Cross, which speaks to them,
sentences.zh: 在整个期间，他们接到了两次重要的访问，一次来自国土安全部部长克里斯蒂·诺姆，另一次来自红十字会，红十字会与他们交谈、

sentences.en: interviews them, and delivers a report to the government of El Salvador, but never makes that report public.
sentences.zh: 采访他们，并向萨尔瓦多政府提交了一份报告，但从未将该报告公之于众。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And as we know, Secretary Noem praises this operation.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所知，诺姆部长对这次行动大加赞赏。

sentences.en: So it would seem she did not hear these kinds of accounts from these men.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来她并没有从这些人那里听到过这种说法。

sentences.en: We don't know what Kristi Noem heard while she was inside the prison.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道克里斯蒂·诺姆在监狱里听到了什么。

sentences.en: What we know is that these men felt so powerless that several of them began to contemplate suicide.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，这些人感到如此无能为力，以至于其中几个人开始考虑自杀。

sentences.en: Luis is one of these men.
sentences.zh: 路易斯就是其中之一。

sentences.en: He had heard inside the prison that if one person died, maybe all of them would be able to go free.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里听说，如果一个人死了，也许所有人都能重获自由。

sentences.en: and he gets a sheet, he gets up on one of the beds and he indicates to his fellow inmates that he's going to hang himself
sentences.zh: 他拿起床单，爬上一张床，向狱友示意他要上吊自杀，

sentences.en: and they pull him down.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把他拉了下来。

sentences.en: He said, were it not for these men, mis compañeros, I would not be here today telling you the story that I'm telling you.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果不是这些人，我的同伴们（mis compañeros），我今天就不会站在这里向你讲述我正在讲述的故事。

sentences.en: I want to ask you what might seem like a somewhat insensitive question, given the really shocking descriptions from these men.
sentences.zh: 我想问你一个听起来可能有点麻木不仁的问题，考虑到这些人令人震惊的描述。

sentences.en: But I think as journalists, we have to ask it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为作为记者，我们必须提出这个问题。

sentences.en: How do you and our colleagues go about making sure that this harrowing testimony is true?
sentences.zh: 你和我们的同事如何确保这令人揪心的证词是真实的？

sentences.en: This is a very important and fair question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要且公平的问题。

sentences.en: Of course, we interviewed 40 of these men.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们采访了其中的40人。

sentences.en: Their testimonies were consistent with each other's, but we weren't inside the prison.
sentences.zh: 他们的证词彼此一致，但我们当时不在监狱里面。

sentences.en: We couldn't speak to the guards.
sentences.zh: 我们无法与狱警交谈。

sentences.en: We couldn't speak to officials in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 我们无法与萨尔瓦多的官员交谈。

sentences.en: And so we wanted somebody else to help us understand how much we should believe these testimonies.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们需要其他人来帮助我们理解我们应该在多大程度上相信这些证词。

sentences.en: And so we reached out to a nonprofit group of forensic experts, and we provided them with a summary of the testimony, as well as photographs of the injuries, in some cases,
sentences.zh: 于是我们联系了一个由法医专家组成的非营利组织，我们向他们提供了证词摘要，以及伤情照片，在某些情况下，

sentences.en: doctors' reports.
sentences.zh: 还有医生报告。

sentences.en: You basically asked them to audit your reporting.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是请他们来审计你们的报道。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what they said was that the testimony and the other evidence that we provided were consistent and credible.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，我们提供的证词和其他证据是一致且可信的。

sentences.en: And they said that in their assessment, much of the abuse that was described met the United Nations definition of torture.
sentences.zh: 他们说，根据他们的评估，所描述的大多数虐待行为符合联合国对酷刑的定义。

sentences.en: And I think it bears repeating that this is torture inflicted on men whose deportation to this prison was not based on any normal legal process.
sentences.zh: 我认为值得重申的是，这是对这样一群人施加的酷刑，他们被驱逐出境并关进这座监狱并不是基于任何正常的法律程序。

sentences.en: They were never tried on allegations of being terrorists.
sentences.zh: 他们从未因被指控为恐怖分子而受审。

sentences.en: In fact, the only judge who ever touched their case was a federal judge in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 事实上，唯一接触过他们案件的法官是一名美国联邦法官，

sentences.en: who tried to stop the flights carrying many of them from ever landing in El Salvador, an order that the Trump administration pretty much ignored.
sentences.zh: 他曾试图阻止载有他们许多人的航班在萨尔瓦多降落，特朗普政府几乎完全无视了这项命令。

sentences.en: And in the case of Luis, yes, there are charges of theft in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就路易斯而言，是的，美国有盗窃指控，

sentences.en: that in theory might merit a regular old deportation.
sentences.zh: 理论上可能值得进行一次常规的驱逐出境。

sentences.en: But in no world would the allegations against someone like him ever seem to justify beatings and torture in a prison in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 但在任何世界里，针对像他这样的人的指控都绝不会被认为足以原谅在萨尔瓦多监狱里遭受的殴打和酷刑。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm curious what motivated the release of these men, if inevitably releasing them would mean that they could tell these stories to the world, stories of essentially torture.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇是什么促成了这些人的释放，如果释放他们不可避免地意味着他们能够向世界讲述这些故事，即本质上的酷刑故事的话。

sentences.en: It's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: And I think that many of us following the story thought that these men might spend the rest of their lives in this prison.
sentences.zh: 我想许多关注这个故事的人都认为这些人可能会在这座监狱里度过余生。

sentences.en: But the Venezuelan government, which wanted the release of these men, had a bargaining chip.
sentences.zh: 但希望释放这些人的委内瑞拉政府手头有一张筹码。

sentences.en: And that bargaining chip is that the government of Nicolás Maduro, the country's autocrat, had been detaining U.S.
sentences.zh: 这张筹码就是，该国独裁者尼古拉斯·马杜罗的政府在过去一年里一直在委内瑞拉境内拘留美国

sentences.en: citizens and U.S.
sentences.zh: 公民和美国

sentences.en: residents inside Venezuela over the last year.
sentences.zh: 居民。

sentences.en: And so by July had amassed a sort of group of 10 U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，截至7月，它已经聚集了一组大约10名美国

sentences.en: prisoners and the government of Venezuela negotiated with the government of the United States the release of these 10 U.S.
sentences.zh: 囚犯，委内瑞拉政府与美国政府谈判释放这10名美国

sentences.en: citizens and residents in exchange for the freedom of these now 252 men who were in the Salvadoran prison.
sentences.zh: 公民和居民，以换取目前被关押在萨尔瓦多监狱中的这252名男子的自由。

sentences.en: So in the end, it's Maduro, not Trump, who forces these men's awful saga to come to an end.
sentences.zh: 所以最后是马杜罗，而不是特朗普，迫使这些男子的悲惨传奇走向终结。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, the Maduro government definitely has a hand in securing these men's freedom.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，马杜罗政府在确保这些人重获自由方面确实出了一份力。

sentences.en: So I just want to reflect on what happened in this prison and why it happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想回想一下这座监狱里发生了什么以及为什么会发生。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, it happened because the Trump administration wanted it to happen.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，它的发生是因为特朗普政府希望它发生。

sentences.en: And I'm old enough, and I suspect you are too,
sentences.zh: 我年纪足够大，我猜你也一样，

sentences.en: to remember when the United States had to reckon in a very visible and official way with the idea that it had carried out torture systematically after 9-11 to those that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 还记得美国不得不以一种非常公开和官方的方式面对这样一个想法：在911事件之后，它对美国

sentences.en: had detained in response to those terror attacks that year.
sentences.zh: 在那年针对那些恐怖袭击所拘留的人员系统性地实施了酷刑。

sentences.en: And when the conduct that occurred to these detainees was revealed, American officials, members of Congress,
sentences.zh: 当对这些被拘留者的行为被揭露时，美国官员、国会议员

sentences.en: were so offended and so convinced that it betrayed America's values that they released a report documenting it so the whole country could see it.
sentences.zh: 感到如此被冒犯，并深信这背叛了美国的价值观，以至于他们发布了一份记录该事件的报告，以便全国都能看到。

sentences.en: And they said, this will never happen again.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这种事绝不会再发生。

sentences.en: And here it is again, not conducted by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而现在它又再次发生，虽然不像911之后那样由美国

sentences.en: per se, as it was after 9-11, but this time, in a sense, outsourced to a foreign country by American government officials.
sentences.zh: 亲自执行，但这一次，在某种意义上，是被美国政府官员外包给了一个外国。

sentences.en: How should we think about that?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待这一点？

sentences.en: it's hard to imagine that u.s officials did not have some idea that something like this was going
sentences.zh: 很难想象美国官员会完全不知道类似的事情将要在萨尔瓦多监狱里

sentences.en: to happen inside the salvadoran prison just two years before these men were sent there the u.s government released its own report it's a public report saying that there was
sentences.zh: 发生。就在这些人被送往那里两年前，美国政府发布了它自己的报告，这是一份公开报告，称有

sentences.en: strong reason to believe that torture was happening inside the salvadoran prison system
sentences.zh: 充分理由相信萨尔瓦多监狱系统内部正在发生酷刑。

sentences.en: Wow, they knew.
sentences.zh: 哇，他们知道。

sentences.en: They knew.
sentences.zh: 他们知道。

sentences.en: And I mean, one of the questions I have is why there has not been more outrage about what these men experienced inside this prison,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我心中的疑问之一是，为什么对于这些人在这座监狱里的遭遇，没有引起更多愤怒，

sentences.en: why we have not seen the same kind of outrage that we saw after 9-11.
sentences.zh: 为什么我们没有看到911之后那种程度的愤怒。

sentences.en: And why do you think that is if you had to make an educated journalistic guess here?
sentences.zh: 如果你必须做出一个受过专业训练的记者猜测，你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's very interesting that the Trump administration and the Bukele administration didn't really try and hide any of this.
sentences.zh: 非常有趣的是，特朗普政府和布克尔政府并没有真正试图掩盖这一切。

sentences.en: Donald Trump came into the White House promising to address the immigration problem at the border in the country in general.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普进入白宫时承诺解决边境和整个国家的移民问题。

sentences.en: And he promised to deter migration.
sentences.zh: 他承诺遏制移民。

sentences.en: And that is what he has done.
sentences.zh: 这就是他所做的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, the numbers at the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国

sentences.en: border are way down.
sentences.zh: 边境的数字大幅下降。

sentences.en: And what I was thinking about a lot as I was reporting this story is how far basically are Americans willing to go for migration deterrence?
sentences.zh: 当我在报道这个故事时，我一直在想，为了遏制移民，美国人到底愿意付出多大代价？

sentences.en: And, you know, when we went to the Trump administration with our findings, they did not deny any of the testimony.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我们带着我们的调查结果去找特朗普政府时，他们并没有否认任何证词。

sentences.en: Instead, a spokeswoman said to us that we should be focusing our reporting elsewhere, specifically on children who had been killed by, quote, vicious illegal aliens.
sentences.zh: 相反，一位女发言人对我们说，我们应该把报道重心放在别处，具体来说是被所谓“恶毒的非法外国人”杀害的儿童身上。

sentences.en: I mean, first of all, that suggests that the men who end up in this prison in El Salvador have killed children, and I don't believe you found any evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，首先，这暗示最终落入萨尔瓦多这座监狱的男子杀害了儿童，我不认为你们找到了任何证据。

sentences.en: Putting that aside, this sounds like a spokesperson for the White House basically saying to the New York Times, we've seen all your reporting,
sentences.zh: 抛开这一点不谈，这听起来像是白宫发言人在对《纽约时报》说，我们已经看过了你们所有的报道，

sentences.en: we've seen these accounts of torture of men we put in this prison, and our response is, who cares?
sentences.zh: 我们看到了我们送进这座监狱的男子的这些酷刑记录，我们的回应是，谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: Which is very striking.
sentences.zh: 这非常惊人。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I should mention that the legal door is still open for the Trump administration to continue sending people to El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 我应该提到的是，特朗普政府继续向萨尔瓦多送人的法律大门仍然敞开着。

sentences.en: And to this prison in El Salvador.
sentences.zh: 而且是送到萨尔瓦多的这座监狱。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I want to end by asking you what has become of men like Luis now that they are released.
sentences.zh: 最后我想问你，像路易斯这样的人现在获释后怎么样了。

sentences.en: Have they achieved anything resembling normalcy now that they are back in Venezuela, a country, of course, that they had sought to flee,
sentences.zh: 既然他们已经回到了委内瑞拉——一个他们原本极力想要逃离的国家，

sentences.en: which is why they came to the United States in the first place.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们最初来到美国的原因，他们现在取得了任何类似正常生活的成果吗？

sentences.en: Now they are back having been through this experience.
sentences.zh: 现在他们经历了这段经历后回来了。

sentences.en: What are they saying life is like right now?
sentences.zh: 他们说现在的生计是什么样的？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Well, Luis, for one, is separated from his family.
sentences.zh: 嗯，路易斯首先就与家人分开了。

sentences.en: His partner and their three children are in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他的伴侣和他们的三个孩子住在美国。

sentences.en: All of these men talked about suffering pretty intense psychological trauma as well as physical probleMs.
sentences.zh: 所有这些人都谈到了遭受相当严重的心理创伤以及身体问题。

sentences.en: They talked about blurred vision, recurring migraines, trouble breathing.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到视力模糊、反复偏头痛、呼吸困难。

sentences.en: Many of them described themselves as zombies, essentially.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人本质上将自己描述为行尸走肉。

sentences.en: This sounds like a form of PTSD.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一种创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: They talked about not being able to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到无法入睡。

sentences.en: And when they do sleep, experiencing a sensation of feeling like they're back in the prison.
sentences.zh: 当他们入睡时，会有一种感觉，觉得自己回到了监狱里。

sentences.en: And one of the men in particular described going to bed and hearing the rattle of handcuffs, the voices of Salvadoran officials, and the clang of his cell door.
sentences.zh: 其中一名男子特别描述了自己上床睡觉时，听到了手铐的哗啦声、萨尔瓦多官员的声音以及牢房门关闭的铿锵声。

sentences.en: Well, Julie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，朱莉，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Since this policy has started, we've gone from 20,000 cases of acute hepatitis B down to 20 per year.
sentences.zh: 自从这项政策开始以来，我们的急性乙型肝炎病例从2万起下降到了每年20起。

sentences.en: Isn't that amazing?
sentences.zh: 这不是很惊人吗？
从2万到20。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the Republican chairman of the Senate Health Committee, Bill Cassidy, recommended that parents vaccinate their newborn babies against hepatitis B,
sentences.zh: 周日，参议院卫生委员会的共和党主席比尔·卡西迪建议父母为刚出生的婴儿接种乙肝疫苗，

sentences.en: despite a controversial vote on Friday by a federal panel, to end that decades-long recommendation.
sentences.zh: 尽管此前在周五，一个联邦专家小组通过了一项颇具争议的投票，决定终止这项长达几十年的建议。

sentences.en: Cassidy said that the government's original recommendation, dating back to 1991,
sentences.zh: 卡西迪表示，政府最初可以追溯到1991年的建议

sentences.en: had prevented thousands of infections and warned that babies who do become infected with hepatitis B are at much higher risk of long-term health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 已经阻止了数千起感染，并警告说，感染乙肝的婴儿在未来面临长期健康问题的风险要高得多。

sentences.en: Those who are infected at birth, 95% of them become chronic carriers.
sentences.zh: 那些在出生时被感染的人，其中95%会成为慢性病毒携带者。

sentences.en: So what does it mean to be a chronic carrier?
sentences.zh: 那么，成为慢性携带者意味着什么？

sentences.en: It means that you're at risk for end-stage liver disease, for liver cancer, for infecting other people.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你面临着罹患终末期肝病、肝癌以及传染给其他人的风险。

sentences.en: But if you vaccinate at birth, that never happens.
sentences.zh: 但如果在出生时接种疫苗，这一切就都不会发生。

sentences.en: And later today, the Supreme Court will hear arguments in a major test of President Trump's power.
sentences.zh: 今天晚些时候，最高法院将就一项对特朗普总统权力具有重大考验的案件听取辩论。

sentences.en: The case revolves around the question of whether Trump can fire a Democratic member of the Federal Trade Commission, an independent agency,
sentences.zh: 该案的核心问题是，特朗普是否可以罢免联邦贸易委员会（一个独立机构）的一名民主党成员，

sentences.en: simply because she is not aligned with his political agenda.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为她的政治立场与他的施政议程不一致。

sentences.en: An existing law says that the president can only remove commissioners for wrongdoing or for neglecting their duties.
sentences.zh: 现行法律规定，总统只能因委员存在不当行为或玩忽职守而将其撤职。

sentences.en: A ruling in Trump's favor would overturn 90 years of legal precedent.
sentences.zh: 若作出有利于特朗普的裁决，将推翻长达90年的法律先例。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感而难以入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝到断片才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么具体要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？
